final: WITH per_site AS (SELECT s.zoneref, si.entrystat, AVG(s.memusagegb) AS avg_ram, AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing AS s JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref CROSS JOIN scanprocessing AS p WHERE s.memusagegb >= 60.8 AND p.flowregistry = s.flowregistry GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_of_site_ram_averages, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_of_site_gpu_cpu_ratio_averages FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat
